repo_language.description: Language of what keel writes into the repository: the note, project memory, session logs, commit messages and new documents. Existing documents keep their own language.

checks.description: Test, lint and type-check commands per monorepo part ('.' for a single project).

security_scanners.description: A scanner that is not installed is a loud warning in the report, not a red gate.

state_in_git.description: Keep next-session.md, memory/ and sessions/ in git.

tier_rules.description: Thresholds the level-proposal script uses. The user always chooses.

basic_max_modules.description: Modules a change may touch and still suggest Basic; more suggest Standard.

large_change_lines.description: Changed lines from which a change counts as large and suggests Standard. A rule of thumb from human code review: reviewers find fewer defects in changes beyond 200-400 lines.

very_large_change_lines.description: Changed lines from which a change counts as very large and suggests Maximum.

core_fan_in.description: A behavior change in a file that this many non-test project files import suggests Maximum (core code). Configs without it use 5.

verification.description: Turn caps are not configured here: each agent's maxTurns in its own file decides (review agents 60, implementer 350; measured p90 about 52 and 342).

comments.description: Code comments. Tricky code (formulas, hidden behaviour, legacy, code that looks wrong) and unclear values or names always get a comment; the level decides plain code. Rules: hooks/comments.md; limits: data/comments.json.

level.description: short: tricky code and unclear values only, plus one line of why for a questionable decision; functions: plus a 1-3 line doc comment on each public function, class and method; detailed: a short doc comment on every function plus headings for the blocks of a long one.

ticket_prefixes.description: Prefixes of the project's ticket and record ids (ABC for ABC-123 and ABC-A-12). comments.js reports such ids in new comment and doc lines. Empty or unset: ticket ids are not checked.

adr_refs.description: Mentions of decision records (ADR-12) in new comments and docs. forbidden: reported in comments, and in docs unless they are a link.

refs_exempt.description: Globs of files where ids are their own subject and are not reported, besides the built-in ones (decision records, task and ticket folders, changelogs).

profile.description: 1 maintenance only (no new docs; existing docs kept true), 2 standard (+ ADR for significant decisions), 3 spec per feature, 4 heavy. The most a task may write; the task size decides. Details: skills/_shared/docs-profiles.md.

pattern.description: Where new docs go; only meaningful for profiles 3-4.

delegation.description: Above either threshold keel asks: here or delegate to implementers? Starting estimate, to be replaced by measurements.

trash_max_age_days.description: Same window as common cloud trash bins (30 days).

in_git.description: true: .keel/tasks/ (goes into git, the team sees every task). false: .keel/local/tasks/ (this machine only). Configs without it use true.

stack_skills.description: Stack skills the user chose during configure (informational).

usage.description: Optional. Usage dashboard shared by a team: the URL of the "keel usage" artifact every member syncs to (otherwise each machine finds its own).

part.description: Path of the monorepo part relative to the project root.
